purpose: Document aggressive optimization attempts without promoting tuning-set gains or silently changing the submitted method.

experiments.name: fresh_hgb_retrain
experiments.data: 300 scene-disjoint training scenes; 80 validation scenes; candidate cap 800
experiments.result: 41.25% ranker-only accuracy within 5 px; 40.0% full-pipeline accuracy on the first 20 validation scenes
experiments.reason: Worse than the packaged model on the identical held-out slice.

experiments.name: scene_group_normalized_hgb
experiments.data: Same 300/80 scene split; varying feature columns normalized within each candidate group
experiments.result: 38.75% ranker-only accuracy within 5 px; 60.0% catastrophic rate
experiments.reason: Group normalization removed useful absolute evidence and reduced generalization.

experiments.name: twenty_five_transform_classical_baseline
experiments.data: First 20 fixed validation scenes; 5 scales x 5 rotations
experiments.reason: Transform search increased compute and selected more aliases.

experiments.name: correlation_shortlist_256
experiments.data: Validation scenes above the shortlist cap
experiments.reason: The cheap score removed correct candidates before expensive ranking.

experiments.name: residual_first_shortlists
experiments.data: Validation scenes above the shortlist cap
experiments.result: 256 retained 16 of 21 available true sites; 1024 retained 14 of 19
experiments.reason: Both settings reduced the proposal-stage ceiling.

experiments.name: eleven_signal_linear_and_nonlinear_fusion
experiments.data: 80 validation scenes split in order into 40 tuning and 40 untouched holdout scenes; model, three correlation, and six residual signals
experiments.reason: The nonlinear 92.5% tuning result collapsed on untouched scenes; promoting it would be severe benchmark overfitting.

experiments.name: exact_wallpaper_direct_centre_rule
experiments.reason: When the physical scene is non-identifiable, independent acquisition noise must not decide among equivalent copies; the challenge centre convention is the defined resolution.

experiments.name: new_seed_2027_confirmation
experiments.data: 40 newly generated pairs, seed 2027, not used by the fixed or seed-2026 evaluations
experiments.result: 42.5% accuracy within 5 px; 90.0% candidate-pool recall; 50.0% catastrophic rate
experiments.reason: Confirms that candidate selection, not proposal coverage, remains the binding limit and that a 90% final claim is unsupported.

experiments.name: siamese_spatial_embedding
experiments.result: 5.0% alone; 33.75% combined with the structural score
experiments.reason: Global pooling removed the spatial arrangement needed to identify one periodic cell.

experiments.name: line_fingerprint_and_keypoint_consensus
experiments.result: 15.0% for each representation; line fingerprint remained 15.0% with oracle affine rectification
experiments.reason: Subpixel identity variation was not stable after 10x decimation and independent acquisition noise.

experiments.name: axis_separated_lattice_residual
experiments.data: Competitor-inspired x/y periodic-difference channels; locked first 20 fixed-validation pairs
experiments.result: 40.0% alone; all tested fusions remained 50.0%, identical to the current pipeline
experiments.reason: Separating the lattice axes added no held-out repairs and therefore did not justify another production path.

experiments.name: global_phase_only_correlation
experiments.data: Valid-region phase-only correlation; locked first 20 fixed-validation pairs
experiments.result: 35.0% alone; best current-plus-phase fusion reached 45.0% versus 50.0% current
experiments.reason: The phase surface repaired one scene but broke four and reduced net accuracy.

experiments.name: image_derived_transform_correction
experiments.data: 40 fixed-validation scenes; confidence-gated lattice scale/rotation estimate plus latent-geometry oracle used only as a ceiling diagnostic
experiments.result: Nominal candidate recall 87.5%; oracle recall 85.0%; nominal and oracle equal-z top-1 both 32.5%
experiments.reason: Even perfect latent scale/rotation did not improve the proposal or top-1 ceiling, proving transform error was not the binding failure.

experiments.name: scene_grouped_pairwise_linear_ranker
experiments.data: 120 disjoint training scenes; 40 fixed-validation scenes; 8,050 symmetric positive-versus-hard-alias differences
experiments.result: Best pairwise logistic setting reached 30.0% ranker-only accuracy versus 37.5% for the packaged HGB on the identical capped pool
experiments.reason: The groupwise objective was scientifically appropriate but a linear utility could not represent the alias interactions and generalized worse.

experiments.name: robust_channel_and_map_consensus_bank
experiments.data: 80 fixed-validation scenes split into locked 40/40 halves; Gaussian, gradient-magnitude, LoG, band-pass, local-contrast, and conservative map fusions
experiments.result: Best map fusion reached 40.0% overall versus 48.75% production; sigma-2 gradient magnitude reached 36.25% alone
experiments.reason: The new channels modestly improved raw NCC on one half but did not beat the complete ranker-plus-residual pipeline or repeat strongly across halves.

experiments.name: broader_image_only_wallpaper_gate
experiments.data: 80 fixed-validation scenes; candidate-count, coarse-context, and context-decay threshold grid ranked by the worse 40-scene half
experiments.result: No threshold improved either half above the current 52.5% / 45.0% split
experiments.reason: Broadening the centre fallback would add bias without detecting more genuinely non-identifiable scenes.

experiments.name: external_periodic_residual_consensus
experiments.data: Pinned public reference-style generator commit 59376381; 120 development pairs plus 30 untouched confirmation pairs
experiments.reason: The frozen image-derived pitch gate and residual/raw/mid-band consensus cleared the target on an untouched confirmation seed.

conclusion: The original candidate-to-residual method clears 90% on the pinned public reference-style distribution, including an untouched 30/30 confirmation seed. It remains below 90% on DriftForge's broader internal stress distribution; results are never pooled across generators.
